name: A Hole in the Sky
source:
Last year, 24 children were tragically lost during a field trip due to the neglect of their teacher. This is a game about remembering them.

[From [url=https://the-happiest-camper.itch.io/a-hole-in-the-sky]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
去年，由于老师的疏忽，24名儿童在一次实地考察中不幸失踪。这是一个关于记住他们的游戏。

[来自[url=https://the-happiest-camper.itch.io/a-hole-in-the-sky]Itch.io[/url]]
